format: html

  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Load county-level election results
county_data <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv")

# Filter for the Governor race and find the winning candidate per county
gov_winners <- county_data |>
  filter(
    office == "Governor",
    !candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes", "WriteinVotes")
  ) |>
  group_by(county) |>
  mutate(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    pct = votes / total_votes
  ) |>
  slice_max(votes, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Standardize county names to match ggplot2 map data
  mutate(
    subregion = tolower(county),
    subregion = recode(
      subregion,
      "desoto" = "de soto",
      "st. johns" = "st johns",
      "st. lucie" = "st lucie"
    )
  )

# Get Florida county map boundary polygons
fl_map <- map_data("county") |>
  filter(region == "florida") |>
  left_join(gov_winners, by = "subregion")

# Plot NPR-style choropleth map of the election winners
ggplot(fl_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = candidate)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Winner",
    values = c(
      "Crist / Hernandez" = "#377eb8",
      "DeSantis / Nuñez" = "#e41a1c"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results by County",
    subtitle = "Ron DeSantis (R) defeated Charlie Crist (D)",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50", hjust = 0.95),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
